purpose: Define the evidence structure and refusal rules for an unbiased first H adsorption screen before any adsorption result exists, without authorizing execution before SURFACE_READY or freezing arbitrary unresolved numerical choices.
native_quantities_to_report: adsorption energy under an independently qualified H reference
maximum residual force on movable degrees of freedom
adsorbate height and relevant nearest-neighbor distances
raw QE provenance and exact numerical settings

required_pre_execution_subprotocols.H2_reference: Freeze and qualify an H2 total-energy reference using the same exchange-correlation and H pseudopotential family before adsorption energies are interpreted.
required_pre_execution_subprotocols.lateral_cell_and_coverage: Freeze an initial surface supercell/coverage plus at least one stronger lateral-interaction challenge before inspecting adsorption results.
required_pre_execution_subprotocols.reciprocal_resolution: Preserve the certified clean-surface reciprocal-space density when scaling the lateral cell, then test adsorption-energy/site-order sensitivity rather than blindly copying the primitive-cell integer mesh.
required_pre_execution_subprotocols.adsorbate_relaxation_depth: Define which Ru layers may respond to H and include a targeted challenge if adsorption materially perturbs the certified clean-surface relaxation depth.
required_pre_execution_subprotocols.dipole_or_boundary_condition: Determine prospectively whether the chosen symmetric/paired-adsorbate construction or an explicit dipole/electrostatic treatment is required; do not change this after site ordering is seen.

decision_structure_to_freeze_before_exec.site_minimum_gate: A reported minimum must be force-converged and mechanically stable under a later local vibrational check before becoming the adsorption-state parent of a reaction path.
decision_structure_to_freeze_before_exec.site_ordering_gate: Site ordering is withheld if numerical/lateral sensitivity can reverse gaps at the scale relevant to the ordering claim.
decision_structure_to_freeze_before_exec.substrate_inheritance_gate: Any adsorption-induced perturbation outside the substrate certificate triggers targeted requalification of the affected dimension rather than silent inheritance.

downstream_if_valid: reaction-path candidate construction from the computed PES
why_not_frozen_for_execution_yet: The clean-surface foundational robustness challenge is unresolved.
The clean-surface relaxation/reproduction gate has not executed.
The substrate certificate is not issued.
Exact lateral-cell/coverage and H-reference numerical choices should be frozen with native numerical justification before adsorption results, not guessed merely to complete paperwork.
